{{Tooltip|W|Won}} 71–65 vs. [[2016-17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] }} {{2016–17 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. It was [[head coach]] [[Roy Williams (coach)|Roy Williams']] 14th season. The Tar Heels played their home games at the [[Dean Smith Center]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. In 2017, they earned their 6th [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA National Championship]] by defeating [[2016-17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the championship game. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|Tar Heels]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] with a record of 33–7, 14–4 in [[2015-16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in first place, winning their 30th ACC regular season title. The Tar Heels also won their 18th [[2016 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] championship by beating [[2015–16 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the finals 61–57. They received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 1 seed. There, they defeated [[2015–16 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]], [[2015–16 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]], [[2015–16 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]], and [[2015–16 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] to earn a trip to the Final Four, the school's 19th Final Four. In a matchup against fellow ACC foe, [[2015–16 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]], the Tar Heels easily won 83–66 to advance to the [[2016 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship Game|National Championship]] against [[2015–16 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]]. Despite a circus shot by [[Marcus Paige]] to tie the game at 74 with less than five seconds remaining, the Tar Heels lost on a three pointer as time expired. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
